attributes.action: Introduce a duty of accountability requiring politicians to answer accurately
attributes.additional_details:
Democratic accountability depends on elected representatives answering questions honestly and meaningfully. Politicians should be free to debate and express opinions, but factual questions should receive clear, relevant and evidence-based responses.

This petition seeks stronger standards requiring representatives to address the substance of questions, distinguish fact from opinion, acknowledge uncertainty and avoid deliberate evasion or misleading statements.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government and Parliament to introduce a duty of accountability requiring elected representatives to provide accurate, relevant answers to questions from Parliament and the public, rather than avoiding scrutiny through misleading statements or irrelevant responses.
